data.name: Vishvaksena
data.gender_notes: Vishvaksena is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vishvaksena is the name of Lord Vishnu's commander in charge of maintaining the order and harmony of the universe. The name Vishvaksena carries the meaning “Commander of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Vishvaksena usually hope their child will grow to embody commander of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who maintains the cosmic order.
data.etymology: Vishvaksena belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Commander of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vishvaksena total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vishvaksena holds a significant place in Hindu mythology and culture. It is often chanted before the beginning of any new venture, such as starting a business or embarking on a journey, to seek his blessings and guidance. Vishvaksena is considered the Supreme Commander of the entire universe, and he assists Lord Vishnu in maintaining the cosmic order and harmony.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Vishvaksena holds deep spiritual significance, representing the celestial sibling and aide of Lord Vishnu. In Hindu mythology, Vishvaksena is considered to be Lord Vishnu's Vahan (vehicle) and his Y shifting (flag). He is a steadfast companion, who is always present by Lord Vishnu's side to serve Him and protect the universe from chaos and disorder.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vishvaksena symbolizes the divine commander and chief architect of the universe, guiding all beings on their spiritual journey. His name signifies all-pervading consciousness and the inner guide leading us towards self-realization.

vedic_reference.note: Vishvaksena is a name of Lord Vishnu and is also the name of the commander-in-chief of his army. It is found in the Vedas and other Hindu scriptures.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Vishvaksena is a name of the god of the gods in the Mahabharata. The name Vishvaksena carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Vishvaksena is the name of the chief minister of the gods in Hindu mythology.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Vishvaksena remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
